events.event: A shell wildcard in a file-hash command selected the sealed blind-key file and emitted its file SHA-256 to that delegated tool session.
Early provider-free verifier runs parsed the completion record to check its no-go field. That record embeds a blind-key digest, so the verifier design indirectly read the digest reference.
A status command printed the one-line completion record and therefore reproduced its embedded blind-key digest in local tool output.

immediate_containment: The delegated audit was stopped immediately after its report.
The verifier was revised to avoid opening the completion record as well as the blind-key file.
No further blind-key access, hashing, comparison, deblinding, scoring, or assignment inference is authorized by this record.
The immutable source artifacts, completion record, and no_go_pending_independent_review state remain unchanged.
required_human_disposition: The Project Owner classified the event as contained_non_substantive_boundary_contact and authorized only noncanonical internal quality use in the separate decision record.
Do not unblind, finalize, promote, or treat any review as satisfying the two-human-review protocol.
Any future review work requiring anonymity should use a clean, independently controlled environment and preserve the existing no-go state.
notes: This incident record intentionally omits the blind-key hash and all blind-key contents. It is a transparency and containment record only; it does not alter a sealed artifact or create any authority beyond the separately recorded noncanonical internal-use direction. The frozen AI-review attestation applies only to conduct before its freeze and must not be read as a clean-attestation for this later governance work.
